title: Pan-Fried Trout with Almonds
description: Crisp-skinned trout fillets in a simple brown butter and toasted almond sauce.
steps: Pan-fry the trout skin-side down until crisp, then flip briefly to finish.
Remove the fish, then toast the almonds in the same pan with the butter until golden.
Add the lemon juice, pour over the fish and finish with parsley.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food fish recipe collection

notes: Trout is milder than salmon and cooks even faster — watch it closely so it does not overcook.
